units: <cite ref="Shabbat 20b:13">Sabb. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>צמר מִכְוַוץ כָּוֵויץ</he> wool (if used as a wick) curls.
<cite ref="Niddah 3a:50">Nidd. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>מוך … מכוץ כויץ</he> the lint … shrinks (and leaves room for the blood to pass).
<cite ref="Sukkah 23b:1">Succ. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דמייתא כַּוְוצָא</he> when the animal is dead, the body shrinks.
<cite ref="Chullin 43b:11">Ḥull. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שחותכו וכויץ</he> that portion of the gullet which shrinks when you cut it.
<cite ref="Shabbat 19a">Sabb. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>וכַוְּוצֵיה</he> for he made it shrink (by using too hot water).

<cite ref="Chullin 46b">Ḥull. 46ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 47b">47ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>בחמימי לא דמְכַוְּוצֵי</he> not in boiling water, for it causes the lungs to shrink (Ar. ed. Koh. <he>בקרירי לא דכווצא</he> not in cold water, for it will contract, v. <cite ref="I00906"><he>טְרַשׁ</he> I</cite>).
